verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street runs an open /resource library of visa guides relevant to founders. It includes a dedicated startup-founders O-1 explainer, criteria-oriented pieces on references and high remuneration, process guides for F-1/J-1-to-O-1 transitions, an O-1 vs EB-1 comparison, and RFE handling, and these are described as open rather than gated. missing for 10: evidence of real case examples or case studies, confirmation the downloadable ebook is ungated, depth/length evidence showing the guides are substantial, independent corroboration.
